use_case: AI-assisted diagnostics: analyzes device diagnostic logs and damage photos and suggests the likely fault and repair
vendor_or_model: Diagnostics vendor (machine learning model trained by the vendor on repair data)
data_categories: Device diagnostic logs (account identifiers stripped since 2026-05); photos of device damage
consequential_decision_category: None directly; influences which repair and price a customer is quoted
human_in_the_loop: Technician must physically inspect and confirm the fault before any quote; the quote screen shows the technician's diagnosis; the customer approves every quote
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (accuracy claims; unneeded repairs); state breach and privacy laws for log data (Florida worked example Fla. Stat. 501.171(2), (6))
status: In production at 960 core stores since 2026-02
bias_testing_status: Local testing on 6,000 devices (2026-06 to 2026-08); gaps flagged for older devices, Manufacturer C consoles, and upsell by store income area
monitoring: Monthly 500-device agreement sample; quarterly bias plan (section 7.4)

use_case: Customer chatbot on the website, app, and text messages: answers repair questions, gives ticket status, books appointments, and gives price ranges from the price list
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (generative language model with retrieval over the FAQ and price list; status lookups through a connector)
data_categories: Customer questions; first name, ticket number, and status; anything customers type (samples found passcodes and card numbers)
consequential_decision_category: None (customer service); escalates if it ever approves refunds, warranty claims, or payment plans
human_in_the_loop: Staff take over on request, for complaints, and for any price outside the price list; the chatbot cannot change tickets or approve anything
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n); state breach and privacy laws for transcripts (Florida worked example Fla. Stat. 501.171(2), (6)); PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1 (card numbers typed into chat); Utah AI Policy Act (Utah Code 13-72 and 13-75, as amended) for Utah customers
status: In production since 2025-09 (about 310,000 chats a month)
bias_testing_status: Scripted and live-chat testing by language; Spanish gap flagged

use_case: Contact center call summarization and agent assist
vendor_or_model: Contact center SaaS vendor (speech-to-text and language model)
data_categories: Call audio and transcripts; customer names and ticket details
human_in_the_loop: Agents review and edit every summary before saving; no automated customer decisions
applicable_laws: State recording consent laws (all-party consent applied everywhere; Florida worked example Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d)); PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.3.1 (recordings must not keep card data); FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n)
bias_testing_status: Summary accuracy sampled by language; no material gap

use_case: Applicant screening and ranking for technician and store roles (feature of the applicant tracking system)
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters see the ranked list and choose whom to interview; ranking paused for New York City roles since 2026-07
applicable_laws: Illinois Public Act 103-0804 (notice; no zip codes as proxies); NYC Local Law 144 (bias audit and notice before use); California Civil Rights Council ADS regulations (2 CCR 11008 and following); California ADMT regulations (11 CCR 7200 and following, from 2027-01-01); Colorado SB26-189 (from 2027-01-01); Title VII (disparate impact remains in the statute); FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n)
status: In production in all states except New York City (about 38,000 applicants a year)
monitoring: None yet; monthly selection-rate report by group planned

use_case: Refund and warranty claim fraud detection that flags transactions and employees for Asset Protection review
data_categories: Refunds, warranty claims, employee IDs, store IDs
consequential_decision_category: None directly; an investigator decides; re-tier to High if flags are used alone for discipline
human_in_the_loop: Asset Protection investigators review every flag; no action without an investigation
applicable_laws: State employment AI laws if flags feed discipline (Colorado SB26-189 from 2027-01-01; Illinois Public Act 103-0804); FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n)

use_case: Parts demand forecasting for stores and depots
vendor_or_model: Company model on Cloud provider B
data_categories: Parts sales and stock history (no personal data)

use_case: Device grading and resale pricing for IT asset disposition (vision model)
business_owner: Director of Sanitization and Asset Recovery
vendor_or_model: Company-tuned vision model on Cloud provider B
data_categories: Photos of sanitized devices (no personal data); grades and prices
human_in_the_loop: Graders confirm a 10% sample; buyers can dispute grades

consequential_decision_category: Possibly Employment (hours and shifts); counsel to decide
human_in_the_loop: Store managers approve and edit every schedule
applicable_laws: Colorado SB26-189 (from 2027-01-01, if scheduling is a consequential employment decision; counsel to decide); FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n)
monitoring: Weekly schedule change rate by store

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant for staff (approved tenant)
vendor_or_model: Generative AI service in the company tenant (Cloud provider B)
data_categories: Internal documents; Confidential data allowed; Restricted data prohibited (POL-04 4.9)
human_in_the_loop: Users review all outputs; no automated decisions
applicable_laws: State breach and privacy laws (data handling); FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n)

use_case: Upsell recommendations at the POS (add-on repairs and accessories)
data_categories: Ticket details, device model, purchase history
consequential_decision_category: None directly; influences what customers are offered
human_in_the_loop: Counter staff choose whether to offer; customers decide
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5, 15 U.S.C. 45(a)(1) and 45(n) (unneeded add-ons; claims)
monitoring: Weekly attach rate and refund rate on add-ons

use_case: Technician productivity scoring (feature of the depot management software) ranking technicians by repair time and rework
build_or_buy: Buy (vendor feature enabled by a 2026-07 update)
data_categories: Technician job times, rework, and quality checks
human_in_the_loop: None designed; scores were visible to depot supervisors before the feature was disabled
applicable_laws: Colorado SB26-189 (from 2027-01-01); Illinois Public Act 103-0804; California ADMT regulations (11 CCR 7200 and following); Title VII
